newsitem.title: USA: XETA Corp optimistic about fiscal Q3.
newsitem.headline: XETA Corp optimistic about fiscal Q3.

text.p: XETA Corp on Tuesday said it was "extremely optimistic" regarding its fiscal third-quarter results and confident of completing another record year.

XETA, which provides telecommunications products and services to the lodging industry, said its earnings for the second quarter ended April 30 rose to $0.24 a share from $0.17 the previous second quarter. XETA earned $0.68 a share in fiscal 1996.

The company said that its backlog was a record high at the beginning of the second quarter and was virtually at the same level at the end of the period, even though had installed new systems at a record rate.
Xeta shares were up 1/4 at 11-3/4 early Tuesday afternoon.
